scene: The brass robot beeps happily as you balance a glowing yellow barrel.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the flat rooftop lane. On the far left sits a tall stack of yellow powder barrels. On the left stands the round brass robot facing right. In the centre you stand on roller skates holding a glowing yellow barrel. On the far right glows an open, lantern-lit workshop entrance.
shown: a humming control panel with brass dials on the robot's chest on the left
a sparkling purple fuse dangling from a stacked barrel in the centre
an open workshop doorway spilling bright red lanterns and smoke on the far right

variants.scene: Your skates click on stone as you hoist a glowing drum of powder.
Golden light warms your hands while the friendly brass robot hums along.
You carry the bright barrel past fireworks, still wondering about {quest}.
